author: ariostas
body:
This PR finishes the implementation of the NanoAODRNTupleOutputModule that I started in #49551.

Since now there is a special release of CMSSW with ROOT 6.40, we can start using the late-model extension of untyped records that was introduced in https://github.com/root-project/root/pull/21088. This allows us to group trigger-like fields into untyped records with boolean subfields and still be able to add new subfields later on if needed. I added some guards so that it still compiles and runs with older versions of ROOT.

Another important thing is that I added projections of subfields to the top level so that things look like the old TTrees to make backward compatibility easier. There is a toggle for it, so hopefully once everyone adapts to the new layout we can turn of the projections.

I also ended up doing some refactoring and cleanup. I used assistance from Claude Code for this, so I'm gonna do some extra review myself before I mark this as ready for review. And since it's a big PR, if you prefer I can split it up into a couple so that it is easier to review.

I've attached some more detailed description of the changes below.

:robot: _AI text below_ :robot:

### Bug fixes

- **Out-of-bounds trigger read.** Trigger indices from a previous run's menu were
  used against the current `TriggerResults` without a bounds check.
- **Version suffixes trimmed repeatedly.** A name was trimmed once per event
  rather than once per menu update, so an already-trimmed name could be truncated
  again.
- **Only trim a real version suffix.** Cutting at the last `_v` regardless of what
  follows turned `HLT_DiJet_vbf` into `HLT_DiJet`, colliding with a genuine
  `HLT_DiJet_v3` and costing one of the two its field. A suffix now has to be `_v`
  followed by digits and nothing else.
- **Duplicate trigger field names.** Two processes contributing the same group, or
  a table column already holding the name, silently collided; the second is now
  written as `<name>_p<process>` with a warning.
- **A job writing no events never closed its output file**  open-ness was tracked
  by the RNTuple writer, which is only created on the first event, instead of by
  the `TFile`.
- **`nanoMetadata` strings were rewritten on every run**, so a multi-run job wrote
  duplicate keys into the file.

### Content parity with the TTree output

- **`bunchCrossing` and `orbitNumber`** were never written. Now present, published
  unsigned as the TTree output does.
- **Lumi-level FlatTables and counter tables were dropped entirely**  `openFile()`
  only looked at `keeps[edm::InRun]`. The `LuminosityBlocks` ntuple now carries
  them.
- **`EventStrings` (`genModel`) is written on every event**, not only at lumi
  boundaries, so each entry is self-contained.
- **All ten `FlatTable` column types are handled on every path.** The top-level
  field paths previously supported only `Float`, `Int32`, `UInt8` and `Bool` and
  silently dropped the rest to stdout. Dispatch now lives in one place
  (`FlatTableColumnDispatch.h`), with no `default` case, so a new column type is a
  compile error rather than missing output.
- **`ZSTD` and `LZ4`** are accepted for `compressionAlgorithm`, matching the TTree
  module; an unknown name now fails at construction instead of at file open.

### Layout changes

- **Trigger flags are grouped into records:** `HLT_IsoMu24` becomes `HLT.IsoMu24`,
  in `HLT`/`Flag`/`L1` records, the same relation the collection fields have to the
  TTree module's `Muon_pt` branches.
- **A trigger path first seen in a later run is no longer dropped.** On ROOT 6.40
  the record grows to take it and entries already written read back false; before
  6.40 the record cannot grow, so the path is written as a top-level field under
  the flat name instead, with a warning. Either way the path reaches the file.
- **Singleton FlatTables are written as records, not vectors of one** 
  `Generator.binvar` rather than `Generator.binvar[0]`, matching the TTree module's
  scalar branches.
- **Every grouped member also gets its TTree branch name** as an RNTuple projected
  field: `GenJet_pt` beside `GenJet.pt`, `HLT_IsoMu24` beside `HLT.IsoMu24`. A
  projection is a second name for the same columns, so it costs nothing on disk
  beyond its schema entry. This addresses the concern that the grouped layout is
  hard to migrate to.

### New configuration

- `flatProjections` (untracked `bool`, default `true`) turns the flat names off.
  With it `False` the output is identical field-for-field and digest-for-digest to
  the run without the feature.

### Tests

- `test/test_catch2_NanoAODRNTupleFields.cc`  a contract test for the RNTuple
  behaviour the module is built on: untyped records and untyped vectors of records,
  flat projections of every column type, and growing a record while the ntuple is
  being written. Its late-extension section is split on `ROOT_VERSION_CODE`, so
  each build tests the path it actually takes.

### Code quality

Dead debug printing removed; unsupported-type reports moved from stdout to
`MessageLogger`; summary-table fields passed by reference; provenance writers moved
into a namespace to avoid an ODR clash with `FWIO/RNTupleTemp*`; a pass over
`plugins/rntuple/` against the CMS coding rules (lower-case namespaces, no C-style
casts, header/source method order).

### Validation

- Workflow `2500.9101` (`DYToLL_M-50_13TeV_pythia8` + NANOGEN) runs to completion
  with and without `--use-rntuple`. Every TTree branch name  100 in `Events`, 10
  in `Runs`, 6 in `LuminosityBlocks`  is now a top-level RNTuple field name,
  except the 12 `n<Collection>` counters RNTuple represents implicitly.
- A dedicated harness drives a run transition with a changing HLT menu (a path
  version-bumped, one dropped, one new), which the workflow cannot do.
- The ROOT 6.40 backfill path was verified on x86_64 against
  `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre2_ROOT640`: the new path lands *inside* the record, false for
  the entries written before it appeared, with its projection resolving onto it.

### Known remaining differences

- The TTree module also keeps any path whose name contains `Scouting` (the
  `DST_PFScouting_*` paths); this module keeps only the `HLT`, `Flag` and `L1`
  prefixes and drops those.
- Named collections are written as *untyped* `std::vector<record>`, so RDataFrame
  cannot JIT an expression against the collection itself (`GenPart.size()`),
  although each member is exposed as its own column and the flat projections are
  ordinary top-level fields.
title: Finish the implementation of NanoAODRNTupleOutputModule
